crossRefs.note: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
Yahweh turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.
He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

translations.web: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
translations.bsb: Indeed, He drew you from the jaws of distress to a spacious and broad place, to a table full of richness.
translations.kjv: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
translations.asv: Yea, he would have allured thee out of distress Into a broad place, where there is no straitness; And that which is set on thy table would be full of fatness.
